environment.timeout_preflight_warning: options.timeout_s (3480s) looks implausible for a tran analysis with ~3.94e+05 timepoints (20p step, 7870n window) -- even 50 timepoints/s (a generous floor, not a real engine-rate estimate) would need 7.87e+03s per corner. This is only a coarse, advisory pre-grid heuristic -- it does not block the sweep, and a plausible-looking budget can still turn out to be too short in practice.
